messages.subject: Non-recursive system in latent variable
parts:
Dear Group,
I have a system of the form

Y ~ X + W + z1
X ~ Y + W + z2

where X, Y and W are latent and z1 and z2 are vectors of other observables, such as demographics.  Is it possible to estimate this system in lavaan?  If so, which features of lavaan should be used?  If not, does anybody have any suggestions?

Best,
Russ

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Non-recursive system in latent variable
parts:
Y ~ X + W + z1
X ~ Y + W + z2

For cross-sectional data, I believe this model will only be identified if you constrain the two X-Y relationships to equality / proportionality.

Y ~ yONx*X + W + z1
X ~ xONy*Y + W + z2
yONx == xONy # or something like " yONx == xONy / 2 "

Terry

messages.author: 99a06696c483481a
messages.subject: RE: Non-recursive system in latent variable
parts:
As long as z1 and z2 are different, the system is identified statistically.  Even better if there is a unique variable in z1 that is not in z2, and vice versa.  There are some wrinkles in lavaan in using observed variables as predictors of factors.  Other than that, this is just a set of equations, the same as any other system of equations in lavaan.  Worst case, you create a factor for each observable, with loading = 1 and residual variance of the single observed variable indicator = 0.

--Ed Rigdon
